note: Lao News Agency (KPL, 30 August 2025) on the new cards: issued from birth to six and from six to fifteen; a first adult card between 15 and 20, then a renewal valid 20 years, then ten years each (the term depending on the holder's history, so it's null here); without expiry from 60; a processing fee of 30,000 kip each. The time isn't stated.

sources.title: Lao News Agency (KPL), Lao PDR to Launch Digital ID Cards Nationwide in October (30 August 2025)
sources.said: For children, cards can be issued from birth to six years of age, and again from six to fifteen years. From age 15 to 20, citizens will receive their first adult ID card, followed by a renewal valid for 20 years. After that, the cards will be valid for 10 years each. For citizens aged 60 and above, digital ID cards will be issued without an expiration date. ... The processing fee for each digital ID card is 30,000 kip.
